description: A fast, modern, information-rich Windows task manager
notes: This is the portable copy: it does not update itself and only links to the download page. Update with 'scoop update argus'.
Settings and history are stored in %APPDATA%\dev.argus.taskmanager and %LOCALAPPDATA%\dev.argus.taskmanager, shared with an installed Argus, and stay after uninstalling.

Optional privileged features write outside scoop after administrator approval: the privileged service to 'C:\Program Files\Argus Privileged' (service 'ArgusPrivileged'), the administrator startup copy to 'C:\Program Files\Argus Runtime', the PawnIO sensor setup to 'C:\Program Files\Argus Sensor Setup'. Remove them in Settings before uninstalling.
Start at sign-in writes the 'Argus' value under HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run; turn it off in Settings before uninstalling.
